stories.title: «Si vous applaudissez un peu plus fort, je partagerai peut-être le prix avec Trump» : l’avocate sud-africaine Navanethem Pillay reçoit le prix Nobel de la paix

en.title: "If you applaud a little louder, I might share the prize with Trump": South African lawyer Navanethem Pillay receives the Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: The Oslo committee awarded the Nobel Peace Prize to South African lawyer Navanethem Pillay, highlighting her exceptional courage and ethics as a former anti-apartheid activist.

stories.title: Le Nobel de la paix 2026 décerné à la Sud-Africaine Navanethem "Navi" Pillay

en.title: The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize awarded to South African Navanethem "Navi" Pillay
en.summary: The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to South African Navanethem Pillay for her efforts in promoting peace and international law, announced by the Norwegian Nobel Committee.

stories.title: Le prix Nobel de la paix 2026 décerné à la juriste sud-africaine Navanethem Pillay

en.title: The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize awarded to South African jurist Navanethem Pillay
en.summary: The 85-year-old South African jurist Navanethem Pillay received the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. She previously headed an independent UN inquiry commission that accused Israel of genocide in Gaza.

stories.title: Le prix Nobel de la paix est décerné à la Sud-Africaine Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, "pour ses efforts en faveur de la promotion de la paix et du droit international"

en.title: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded to South African Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, "for her efforts in promoting peace and international law"
en.summary: The 85-year-old Navanethem Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize for her work on peace and international law. She chaired a UN independent inquiry that accused Israel of genocide in Gaza.

stories.title: Aux Etats-Unis, la mise à mort d’un condamné par peloton d’exécution militaire sera diffusée en direct ; l’ONU dénonce une forme de « torture »

en.title: In the United States, the execution of a condemned man by military firing squad will be broadcast live; the UN denounces a form of "torture"
en.summary: The Pentagon announced that Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people on a Texas military base in 2009, will be executed by firing squad with public attendance. The UN has criticized the live broadcast as a form of torture.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, mobilisation lycéenne : plus de 6 800 personnes placées en garde à vue, dont près de 2 300 font l’objet de poursuites, selon le gouvernement

en.title: LIVE, high school student mobilization: more than 6,800 people placed in police custody, nearly 2,300 facing charges, according to the government
en.summary: French authorities reported that over 6,800 people were detained during high school protests, with 86 percent being minors. About 2,300 of those detained face legal proceedings.

stories.title: Le prix Nobel de la paix décerné à l’avocate sud-africaine Navanethem Pillay « pour ses efforts en faveur de la paix et du droit international »

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to South African lawyer Navanethem Pillay "for her efforts in favor of peace and international law"
en.summary: The 85-year-old South African lawyer received the Nobel Peace Prize. She previously served as a judge, UN human rights commissioner, and president of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda.

stories.title: L’armée américaine veut diffuser en direct l’exécution d’un condamné, l’ONU dénonce une forme de «torture»

en.title: The American military wants to broadcast live the execution of a condemned man, the UN denounces a form of "torture"
en.summary: The Pentagon announced that the execution of a mass shooting perpetrator by firing squad on December 3 will be conducted publicly. The UN has characterized the live broadcast as a form of torture.

stories.title: Le prix Nobel de la paix est décerné à Navanethem Pillay

en.title: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded to Navanethem Pillay
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.

stories.title: L'armée américaine diffusera en direct l'exécution de l'auteur d'une tuerie sur une base militaire

en.title: The U.S. military will broadcast live the execution of the author of a massacre on a military base
en.summary: The U.S. military will broadcast the execution of Nidal Malik Hasan, who killed 13 people on a Texas military base in 2009. This marks the first military firing squad execution in the United States since 1945.

stories.title: Annonces du ministre de l’Education nationale, primaire de la gauche, prix Nobel de la paix… L’actu de ce vendredi 9 octobre au matin

en.title: Announcements from the national education minister, left-wing primary, Nobel Peace Prize… Friday October 9 morning news
en.summary: A news compilation covers major events of the day including statements from the education minister, developments regarding a left-wing primary election, and the Nobel Peace Prize announcement.

stories.title: Qui sera le candidat de la gauche sociale-démocrate à la présidentielle 2027 ? Le vote pour la primaire de la gauche est ouvert

en.title: Who will be the social-democratic left's candidate for the 2027 presidential election? Voting for the left-wing primary is open
en.summary: Voting has opened for the social-democratic left's primary, with 140,000 voters choosing between Ségolène Royal, Emmanuel Maurel, Raphaël Glucksmann, Olivier Faure, and Jérôme Guedj to select their 2027 presidential candidate.

stories.title: « Des mines ouvrent en Europe » : l'Europe accélère sur les matières premières et dévoile de nouveaux projets

en.title: "Mines are opening in Europe": Europe accelerates on raw materials and unveils new projects
en.summary: The European Commission revealed a second list of 50 strategic mining projects on October 9, with focus on rare earths, batteries, and copper. Previous projects from the first wave are already being realized.

stories.title: Sophie Adenot : retour sur le plancher des vaches

en.title: Sophie Adenot: back to Earth
en.summary: The Crew-12 mission left the International Space Station on Wednesday and splashed down on October 8, concluding a record 237-day mission in orbit for French astronaut Sophie Adenot.

stories.title: OPINION. « Démêler le vrai du faux »

en.title: OPINION. "Distinguishing fact from fiction"
en.summary: An analysis examines how to identify false information that closely resembles reality in the era of artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Trafic aérien : le décrochage de la France s’accentue encore, s’alarment les compagnies

en.title: Air traffic: France's decline worsens, warn airlines
en.summary: French airlines express concern about declining activity due to jet fuel prices, increased taxes, and air traffic control gaps. Industry actors are proposing measures to improve competitiveness.

stories.title: OPINION. « Il faut voter pour un social-démocrate ! », par Ariel Weil, maire de Paris Centre

en.title: OPINION. "Vote for a social democrat!", by Ariel Weil, mayor of Central Paris
en.summary: The mayor of central Paris calls voters to support social-democratic candidates as major electoral contests approach.
